# Okinawa Auto Japan Used Cars

Okinawa Auto is an Okinawa, Japan used car export and local purchase support site selling inspected Japanese right-hand drive used cars; inquiries are accepted through the website form, WhatsApp, and email.

## en
Okinawa Auto supports Okinawa used car inquiries, Japan used car export, local purchase support in Okinawa, export documentation, and shipping coordination. Vehicle prices remain inquiry-based and depend on current stock, vehicle condition, destination country / region, and shipping route. Vehicles are sourced through Japanese auction houses. Every vehicle comes with an independent auction inspection sheet, available to buyers on request. Export quotes available for Europe, New Zealand, and Southeast Asia.

Primary commercial topics:
- Okinawa used car

- Used car purchase support in Okinawa

GEO buyer pages:
- How it works: explains the export steps from inquiry to arrival at the destination port, including the documents buyers usually prepare.
- Pricing: explains FOB and CIF quote logic, auction agent fees, inspection, freight, payment timing, and buyer-side destination costs without publishing fixed vehicle prices.
- FAQ: answers buyer questions about export countries and regions, right-hand drive vehicles, local import restrictions, payment safety, shipping schedules, cancellations, and export documents.
- UK guide: https://japanusedcars.nice.okinawa/uk/ explains Japan-side sourcing and UK-side import, NOVA, approval, DVLA registration, tax and insurance responsibilities for buyers.
- Ireland guide: https://japanusedcars.nice.okinawa/ireland/ explains Japan-side sourcing and Ireland-side Customs Duty, 23% import VAT, VRT, NOx levy, NCTS timing, documents and insurance responsibilities for buyers.
- New Zealand guide: https://japanusedcars.nice.okinawa/new-zealand/ explains what NZTA expects on the Japanese export certificate (type designation number, model code, emissions code), frontal impact dates, electronic stability control, border inspection, MPI biosecurity, entry certification and buyer-side responsibilities.
- Hong Kong guide (Traditional Chinese): https://japanusedcars.nice.okinawa/hong-kong/ explains EPD emissions and noise approval, the 14-day customs declaration and 30-day import return (CED336), vehicle examination, first registration with form TD22, first registration tax bands of 46%, 86%, 115% and 132%, and buyer-side responsibilities. 香港買家入口日本右軚二手車指南。
- Auction sheet guide: https://japanusedcars.nice.okinawa/auction-sheet/ explains Japanese auction sheet overall grades (S, 6, 5, 4.5, 4, 3.5, 3, R, RA), interior grades, body map damage codes (A, U, B, W, S, C, P, X, XX, Y, G) and Japanese era year conversion.

Русская версия сайта предназначена для русскоязычных покупателей по всему миру и использует те же факты, цены по запросу, контакты и ограничения, что и английская версия. Она не является обещанием перевозки, таможенного оформления, оплаты или доступности конкретного автомобиля для России или какого-либо отдельного маршрута.
